DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia

The "double bubble" sign on your abdominal X-ray, combined with bilious vomiting starting within the first day of life, is pathognomonic for duodenal atresia. This condition typically presents in newborns without meconium passage and is often associated with Down syndrome.
